description: This Java class 'GeneratePackActivitySources' is a custom Gradle task that automates the generation of Android activity source files, manifest, and resource files based on templates and input files. It manages file copying, XML resource creation, and template processing for building Android app components.

classes.name: GeneratePackActivitySources
classes.description: A custom Gradle task class that generates Android activity source files, manifest, and resource files from templates and input files.

methods.name: generatePackActivitySources
methods.description: Main task action that orchestrates the creation of source files, manifest, and resources.

methods.name: clearTargetFile
methods.description: Utility method to delete or create necessary directories for output files.

methods.name: copyScreenshotResourceFile
methods.description: Copies the screenshot image to the output resources directory.

methods.name: createStringResourceFile
methods.description: Creates an XML string resource file from a source text file.

methods.name: createActivityJavaSourceFile
methods.description: Generates the main activity Java source file from a template.

methods.name: createActivityTestJavaSourceFile
methods.description: Generates the main activity test Java source file from a template.

methods.name: createApkManifestSourceFile
methods.description: Creates the AndroidManifest.xml file from a template.
